result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage, including occurrence-based CGL, to continue for one year after the Term, which exceeds the playbook position. The original general-provisions language is otherwise preserved, though “Customer data” should match the defined term “Customer Data,” and cyber/privacy coverage should be stated consistently with the playbook.
